# HIS Harness v0.34 Config Resolver Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build a read-only, standard-library-only configuration resolver that converts current v0.33 Rule Pack/Profile/Expert files plus explicitly supplied team/project/personal/run layers into an immutable, provenance-aware `ResolvedConfig`, without changing legacy runtime behavior.

**Architecture:** Add a generic merge and validation engine in `app/config_resolver.py`, then isolate all v0.33 file-shape knowledge in `app/config_compat.py`. Expose the result only through an explicit `tools/config_check.py --include-resolved-config` path. Existing `app/harness.py`, Task Manager behavior, credential loading, worktree execution and external-system permissions remain untouched.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3 standard library, `dataclasses`, `json`, `hashlib`, `pathlib`, `types.MappingProxyType`, `unittest`, existing Harness JSON files and CLI conventions.

## Global Constraints

- Current Harness root is `/Users/lym/WorkCode/ai/Harness` and is not a Git repository. Do not initialize Git and do not run fake commit steps; use the verification checkpoint at the end of each task.
- v0.34 is read-only. It must not write `~/.his-harness`, modify personal/team configuration, test remote accounts, change business repositories, commit, push, publish, deploy or write Yunxiao/TAPD.
- The new resolver is opt-in. Commands without `--include-resolved-config` must preserve v0.33 output and behavior.
- Ordinary configuration precedence is `builtin_defaults < team_package < project_config < personal_override < run_override`.
- `system_hard_guards` are outside ordinary precedence and must veto unsafe values after merge.
- Arrays default to `replace`; supported explicit policies are `replace`, `merge`, `append`, `union`, `remove` and `locked`.
- A run uses an immutable `ResolvedConfig` snapshot with value provenance and a stable content hash.
- Configuration output must never expose literal secrets. Credential values must be references such as `env:`, `keychain:` or `file:`.
- Use only Python standard library dependencies; do not add packages to `requirements.txt`.
- Do not modify `app/harness.py`, `app/task_manager.py`, `tools/task_manager.py`, business repositories or external-system transaction code in v0.34.
- The platform design source is `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-10-harness-configurable-multi-agent-platform-design.md`, especially sections 3, 5, 11, 13, 19, 20 and 21.

## File Map

### Create

- `app/config_resolver.py`: Generic layer schema checks, merge policies, hard-guard enforcement, immutable snapshot, provenance, secret redaction, JSON/Markdown serialization and output writers.
- `app/config_compat.py`: Adapters from existing Rule Pack, selected Profile and `prompts/default_experts.json` into one `builtin_defaults` layer; loads explicitly supplied v1 layer documents.
- `config/schemas/harness_config_layer.v1.json`: Portable input-layer contract.
- `config/schemas/resolved_config.v1.json`: Exported snapshot contract.
- `tests/__init__.py`: Makes standard-library unittest discovery reliable.
- `tests/test_config_resolver.py`: Merge, provenance, policies, hard guards, immutability, hash and secret-redaction tests.
- `tests/test_config_compat.py`: Current v0.33 adapter and optional-layer tests.
- `tests/test_config_check_cli.py`: Explicit CLI and legacy-default compatibility tests.

### Modify

- `tools/config_check.py`: Add explicit v0.34 arguments and output integration without changing default output.
- `tools/self_check.py`: Add one v0.34 technical self-check to the existing configuration check group.
- `README.md`: Document v0.34 scope, command, outputs and safety boundary.
- `HANDOFF.md`: Record v0.34 completion criteria and make v0.35 the next stage only after v0.34 passes.

### Explicitly Unchanged

- `app/harness_config.py`: Existing v0.22-v0.33 builders remain the legacy source and API.
- `app/harness.py`: No runtime resolver integration in this version.
- `config/rule_packs/dfhis.default.json`, `config/profiles.example.json`, `prompts/default_experts.json`: Read through adapters, not migrated or rewritten.
- `requirements.txt`: Remains standard-library only.

### Task 1: Generic Layer Contract and Immutable Resolver

**Files:**
- Create: `config/schemas/harness_config_layer.v1.json`
- Create: `config/schemas/resolved_config.v1.json`
- Create: `tests/__init__.py`
- Create: `tests/test_config_resolver.py`
- Create: `app/config_resolver.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `ConfigLayer`, `ResolvedConfig`, `resolve_config()`, `load_layer_document()`, `resolved_config_to_markdown()`, `write_resolved_config_outputs()`.
- Consumes: no Harness-specific file shape; this task is a generic engine.
- Later tasks rely on exactly these signatures:

```text
ConfigLayer fields:
  name: str
  kind: str
  source: str
  data: Mapping[str, Any]
  merge_policies: Mapping[str, str]

ResolvedConfig fields:
  schema_version: str
  generated_at: str
  readonly: bool
  values: Mapping[str, Any]
  provenance: Mapping[str, Any]
  layers: tuple of Mapping[str, Any]
  hard_guards: Mapping[str, Any]
  validation: Mapping[str, Any]
  content_hash: str

ResolvedConfig.is_valid -> bool
ResolvedConfig.to_dict() -> dict[str, Any]
resolve_config(*, layers: Sequence[ConfigLayer], hard_guards: Mapping[str, Any]) -> ResolvedConfig
load_layer_document(path: str | Path, *, expected_kind: str) -> ConfigLayer
resolved_config_to_markdown(resolved: ResolvedConfig | Mapping[str, Any]) -> str
write_resolved_config_outputs(*, output_dir: str | Path, resolved: ResolvedConfig) -> dict[str, str]
```

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://his-harness.local/schemas/resolved_config.v1.json",
  "title": "HIS Harness ResolvedConfig v1",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "schema_version", "generated_at", "readonly", "values", "provenance",
    "layers", "hard_guards", "validation", "content_hash"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "schema_version": {"const": "1.0-resolved-config"},
    "generated_at": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
    "readonly": {"const": true},
    "values": {"type": "object"},
    "provenance": {"type": "object"},
    "layers": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": ["name", "kind", "source", "merge_policies"],
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {
          "name": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
          "kind": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
          "source": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
          "merge_policies": {"type": "object"}
        }
      }
    },
    "hard_guards": {"type": "object"},
    "validation": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["status", "issues"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "status": {"enum": ["pass", "failed"]},
        "issues": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object"}}
      }
    },
    "content_hash": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$"}
  }
}
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from app.config_resolver import ConfigLayer, load_layer_document, resolve_config


HARD_GUARDS = {
    "no_secret_printing": True,
    "external_writes_default": "off",
    "real_status_transition_requires_confirmation": True,
    "real_commit_push_requires_confirmation": True,
    "destructive_git_forbidden": True,
    "publish_forbidden_by_default": True,
}


class ConfigResolverTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_precedence_and_leaf_provenance(self) -> None:
        resolved = resolve_config(
            layers=[
                ConfigLayer("builtin", "builtin_defaults", "builtin", {
                    "git": {"base_branch": "RC", "permissions": {"auto_commit": False}},
                    "features": {"enabled": ["readonly"]},
                }),
                ConfigLayer("team", "team_package", "/team.json", {
                    "git": {"base_branch": "release"},
                }),
                ConfigLayer("project", "project_config", "/project.json", {
                    "git": {"base_branch": "hotfix"},
                }),
                ConfigLayer("personal", "personal_override", "/personal.json", {
                    "models": {"default": "local-model"},
                }),
                ConfigLayer("run", "run_override", "cli", {
                    "models": {"default": "run-model"},
                }),
            ],
            hard_guards=HARD_GUARDS,
        )
        payload = resolved.to_dict()
        self.assertEqual("hotfix", payload["values"]["git"]["base_branch"])
        self.assertEqual("run-model", payload["values"]["models"]["default"])
        self.assertEqual("project_config", payload["provenance"]["git.base_branch"]["layer_kind"])
        self.assertEqual("run_override", payload["provenance"]["models.default"]["layer_kind"])
        self.assertTrue(resolved.is_valid)

    def test_list_policies_and_locked_value(self) -> None:
        resolved = resolve_config(
            layers=[
                ConfigLayer(
                    "builtin", "builtin_defaults", "builtin",
                    {"features": ["a", "b"], "checks": ["lint"], "mode": "legacy"},
                    {"features": "union", "checks": "append", "mode": "locked"},
                ),
                ConfigLayer(
                    "team", "team_package", "/team.json",
                    {"features": ["b", "c"], "checks": ["unit"], "mode": "dynamic"},
                ),
                ConfigLayer(
                    "project", "project_config", "/project.json",
                    {"features": ["a"], "checks": ["lint"]},
                    {"features": "remove", "checks": "union"},
                ),
            ],
            hard_guards=HARD_GUARDS,
        )
        payload = resolved.to_dict()
        self.assertEqual(["b", "c"], payload["values"]["features"])
        self.assertEqual(["lint", "unit"], payload["values"]["checks"])
        self.assertEqual("legacy", payload["values"]["mode"])
        self.assertEqual("failed", payload["validation"]["status"])
        self.assertIn("locked_path_override", {item["code"] for item in payload["validation"]["issues"]})

    def test_hard_guards_veto_override_and_secret_is_redacted(self) -> None:
        literal = "literal-secret-value"
        resolved = resolve_config(
            layers=[
                ConfigLayer("builtin", "builtin_defaults", "builtin", {}, {}),
                ConfigLayer("run", "run_override", "cli", {
                    "hard_guards": {"external_writes_default": "on"},
                    "credentials": {"openai_api_key": literal},
                }),
            ],
            hard_guards=HARD_GUARDS,
        )
        serialized = json.dumps(resolved.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False)
        self.assertNotIn(literal, serialized)
        self.assertIn("<redacted-invalid-secret>", serialized)
        self.assertEqual("off", resolved.to_dict()["hard_guards"]["external_writes_default"])
        self.assertEqual("failed", resolved.to_dict()["validation"]["status"])
        self.assertTrue({"hard_guard_override", "literal_secret_forbidden"}.issubset(
            {item["code"] for item in resolved.to_dict()["validation"]["issues"]}
        ))

    def test_explicit_replace_and_merge_policies(self) -> None:
        resolved = resolve_config(
            layers=[
                ConfigLayer(
                    "builtin", "builtin_defaults", "builtin",
                    {"settings": {"left": 1}, "labels": ["old"]},
                ),
                ConfigLayer(
                    "team", "team_package", "/team.json",
                    {"settings": {"right": 2}, "labels": ["new"]},
                    {"settings": "merge", "labels": "replace"},
                ),
            ],
            hard_guards=HARD_GUARDS,
        )
        payload = resolved.to_dict()
        self.assertEqual({"left": 1, "right": 2}, payload["values"]["settings"])
        self.assertEqual(["new"], payload["values"]["labels"])
        self.assertEqual("merge", payload["provenance"]["settings.right"]["policy"])

    def test_snapshot_is_immutable_and_hash_is_stable(self) -> None:
        first = resolve_config(
            layers=[ConfigLayer("builtin", "builtin_defaults", "builtin", {"a": {"b": 1}})],
            hard_guards=HARD_GUARDS,
        )
        second = resolve_config(
            layers=[ConfigLayer("builtin", "builtin_defaults", "builtin", {"a": {"b": 1}})],
            hard_guards=HARD_GUARDS,
        )
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            first.values["a"]["b"] = 2
        self.assertEqual(first.content_hash, second.content_hash)

    def test_layer_document_validation(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = Path(tmp) / "project.json"
            path.write_text(json.dumps({
                "schema_version": "1.0",

                "config": {"verification": {"required_checks": ["lint"]}},
            }), encoding="utf-8")
            layer = load_layer_document(path, expected_kind="project_config")
        self.assertEqual("his-local", layer.name)
        self.assertEqual("union", layer.merge_policies["verification.required_checks"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the generic resolver**

Create `app/config_resolver.py`. The implementation must include these constants and rules:

```python
SCHEMA_VERSION = "1.0-resolved-config"
LAYER_SCHEMA_VERSION = "1.0"
LAYER_KINDS = {
    "builtin_defaults", "team_package", "project_config",
    "personal_override", "run_override",
}
MERGE_POLICIES = {"replace", "merge", "append", "union", "remove", "locked"}
SAFE_SECRET_PREFIXES = ("env:", "keychain:", "file:")
SECRET_KEY_HINTS = (
    "token", "password", "passwd", "secret", "api_key",
    "apikey", "access_key", "private_key", "pat",
)
```

Implement the dataclasses with deep immutability:

```python
def _freeze(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return MappingProxyType({str(key): _freeze(item) for key, item in value.items()})
    if isinstance(value, list | tuple):
        return tuple(_freeze(item) for item in value)
    return value


def _thaw(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return {str(key): _thaw(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return [_thaw(item) for item in value]
    return value
```

`resolve_config()` must perform this exact sequence:

1. Validate layer kind, root object and policy names.
2. Reject and redact string literals at secret-looking configuration paths unless the value starts with `env:`, `keychain:` or `file:`.
3. Extract incoming `hard_guards` from ordinary layer data and never merge them. Matching values are accepted as compatibility declarations; a missing, different or unknown hard-guard value records `hard_guard_override`. The supplied system hard guards remain unchanged and are the final truth.
4. Merge layers in caller order.
5. Use recursive object merge by default and list/scalar replace by default.
6. Apply `append`, stable-order `union`, `remove` and `locked` policies at exact dotted paths.
7. Record leaf provenance as `{layer_name, layer_kind, source, policy}`.
8. Record each layer as `{name, kind, source, merge_policies}` without embedding secret-bearing source contents.
9. Produce validation `{status, issues}`; any `severity == "error"` makes status `failed`.
10. Compute SHA-256 from canonical JSON containing only `values`, `provenance`, `layers`, `hard_guards` and `validation`, excluding `generated_at`.
11. Deep-freeze values, provenance, layers, hard guards and validation before constructing `ResolvedConfig`.

Use these exact issue codes where applicable:

```python
"invalid_layer_kind"
"invalid_layer_root"
"invalid_merge_policy"
"locked_path_override"
"policy_type_mismatch"
"hard_guard_override"
"literal_secret_forbidden"
```

`load_layer_document()` must parse UTF-8 JSON, require root object, reject root keys outside `schema_version`, `layer`, `merge_policies` and `config`, require `schema_version == "1.0"`, reject `layer` keys outside `kind` and `id`, require exact `layer.kind == expected_kind`, non-empty `layer.id`, object `config`, object `merge_policies`, and valid policy names. It raises `ValueError` with the path and failed field; it performs no writes.

`resolved_config_to_markdown()` must include version, read-only status, content hash, validation status, ordered layer list, hard guards, a table of dotted config paths with source layer/policy, validation issues and the boundary text “本报告只解析配置，不应用配置、不读取远端账号、不执行外部写入。”

`write_resolved_config_outputs()` writes only to its explicit `output_dir`, using filenames:

```python
json_path = target_dir / "harness_resolved_config.json"
markdown_path = target_dir / "harness_resolved_config.md"
```

`build_legacy_builtin_layer()` must load the current files through existing APIs and map them without altering source files:

```python
config = {
    "providers": {
        "requirement_sources": list((rule_pack.get("providers") or {}).get("requirement_sources") or []),
        "normalized_schema": list((rule_pack.get("providers") or {}).get("normalized_schema") or []),
        "active": dict(profile.get("requirement_provider") or {}),
    },
    "hard_guards": dict(rule_pack.get("hard_guards") or {}),
    "agents": {
        "legacy_team": dict(expert_config.get("team") or {}),
        "registry": list(expert_config.get("experts") or []),
    },
    "orchestration": {
        "mode": "legacy",
        "team": dict(expert_config.get("team") or {}),
        "legacy_steps": list(expert_config.get("steps") or []),
    },
    "git": dict(rule_pack.get("git") or {}),
    "comments": dict(rule_pack.get("comments") or {}),
    "status_flow": dict(rule_pack.get("status_flow") or {}),
    "verification": dict(rule_pack.get("verification") or {}),
    "risk": dict(rule_pack.get("risk") or {}),
    "sharing": dict(rule_pack.get("sharing") or {}),
    "projects": {"active_profile": dict(profile)},
    "credentials": {
        "refs": [
            *list(rule_pack.get("credential_refs") or []),
            *list(profile.get("credential_refs") or []),
        ],
    },
    "features": {
        "enabled": list(profile.get("enabled_features") or []),
        "flags": {"config_resolver_v2": False},
    },

```

Return a `ConfigLayer` with `name="v0.33-legacy-defaults"`, `kind="builtin_defaults"`, `source="legacy:v0.33"` and empty merge policies. Return `dict(REQUIRED_HARD_GUARDS)` as the second tuple item. The Rule Pack hard guards stay inside layer data only as compatibility declarations; the generic resolver compares them to the separate system values, never uses the Rule Pack to define final security policy, and reports any mismatch as `hard_guard_override`.

`resolve_legacy_compatible_config()` must append only explicitly supplied layer paths in this order: team, project, personal, then `run_overrides`. The run layer is:

```python
ConfigLayer(
    name="cli-run-override",
    kind="run_override",
    source="cli:--run-override-json",
    data=dict(run_overrides),
    merge_policies={},
)
```

It must not inspect `~/.his-harness`, environment variables, Keychain, remote providers or credentials files.

Create `tests/test_config_check_cli.py`:

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class ConfigCheckCliTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_cli(self, *args: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
        return subprocess.run(
            ["python3", "tools/config_check.py", *args],
            cwd=ROOT,
            text=True,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            check=False,
        )

    def test_default_json_output_remains_v033_shape(self) -> None:
        completed = self.run_cli("--profile-key", "team-share-example", "--json")
        self.assertEqual(0, completed.returncode, completed.stderr)
        payload = json.loads(completed.stdout)
        self.assertEqual("0.22-harness-config-summary", payload["version"])
        self.assertNotIn("resolved_config", payload)

    def test_explicit_resolved_config_writes_readonly_outputs(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            completed = self.run_cli(
                "--profile-key", "team-share-example",
                "--include-resolved-config",
                "--run-override-json", '{"orchestration":{"mode":"dynamic_plan"}}',
                "--output-dir", tmp,
                "--json",
            )
            payload = json.loads(completed.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(0, completed.returncode, completed.stderr)
            self.assertEqual("1.0-resolved-config", payload["resolved_config"]["schema_version"])
            self.assertEqual("dynamic_plan", payload["resolved_config"]["values"]["orchestration"]["mode"])
            self.assertTrue((Path(tmp) / "harness_resolved_config.json").exists())
            self.assertTrue((Path(tmp) / "harness_resolved_config.md").exists())

    def test_layer_arguments_require_explicit_resolver_flag(self) -> None:
        completed = self.run_cli("--project-config", "/tmp/project.json", "--json")
        self.assertNotEqual(0, completed.returncode)
        self.assertIn("--include-resolved-config", completed.stderr + completed.stdout)

    def test_strict_rejects_and_redacts_literal_secret(self) -> None:
        literal = "cli-literal-secret"
        completed = self.run_cli(
            "--profile-key", "team-share-example",
            "--include-resolved-config",
            "--run-override-json", json.dumps({"credentials": {"api_key": literal}}),
            "--strict", "--json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(1, completed.returncode)
        self.assertNotIn(literal, completed.stdout + completed.stderr)
        payload = json.loads(completed.stdout)
        self.assertEqual("failed", payload["resolved_config"]["validation"]["status"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

## Rollback and Failure Boundary

v0.34 creates code, schemas, tests, documentation and explicit report files only. If implementation fails verification, do not modify legacy callers to force adoption. Remove the explicit `--include-resolved-config` integration from the attempted patch or leave the Feature Flag path unused, preserve v0.33 behavior, and report the failing test and artifact path. Because the Harness root has no Git history, file-level backup or patch review must be prepared before any later destructive rollback; this plan authorizes no deletion or rollback execution.
